verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no such control. The closest item is tenant-level control over whether AI features are enabled, which is an adjacent setting rather than a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
